title: The Consumer Guys - Videos
description:
Join consumer attorneys Abbas Kazerounian and Mike Kazerouni as they discuss the latest developments in consumer law, how to protect yourself from bad actors, and break down the need to know information that affects YOU as a consumer today. 

Now available on iTunes! : https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-know-your-rights-consumer-lawcast/id1499904867
